name: THE PATRONS
note: One of the Nugget’s nine. Doc 05 gives THE PATRONS its words as a single hotspot, so these carry no tree -- the dog’s precedent. Two men talking, one gesturing with a glass.

sprite.note: Two-frame breath, on its own rate and phase.

placeNote: MEASURED AGAINST THE FURNITURE, not estimated. The first pass put the card players around empty air in front of the piano -- the plate’s round table is at x700-1010 centred on 855, and I had placed them at 700, its left edge -- and the drinkers on open floor with a gap between them and a bar whose face runs diagonally behind the stools at x1125-1330. Tyler: they are not properly on anything. They are now.
